measurement: One time-weighted measured pack-power mean per flight on its frozen eligible intervals.
metrics: Bias is prediction minus measurement. MAE averages absolute errors. RMSE is the square root of the mean squared error. Primary weights every flight equally. The equal-speed summary gives one third weight to each commanded speed and equal flight weights within speed.
paired_change: Difference of absolute errors of two predictions for each identical field flight. Negative mean change indicates a smaller MAE for the named model.

date_cluster_bootstrap.method: Sample the observed flight dates with replacement within each subgroup. Retain all flights on each sampled date and share date multiplicities across all model predictions. For equal-speed weighting, omit replicates missing any registered speed and report the number retained. At least two distinct dates are required to calculate an interval. Intervals with few dates are descriptive. These intervals quantify pointwise variation across the observed dates only.

scope: The original speed evaluation flights belong to the same CMU field collection as the fit set. Five flights had already been examined in the native paired check. The other 28 are a sensitivity subgroup of the previously evaluated set. Holdout scores are descriptive for these field conditions.
